about:
Waterbury Electronic Supply was founded in 1995 in Waterbury, Connecticut. The company operates as a franchised distributor of electronic components from its headquarters at 47 Stevens Street.

The firm supplies a broad range of electronic parts including connectors, relays, switches, power supplies, displays, enclosures, and automation control components. In addition to distribution, it offers sheet metal fabrication and off‑shore PCB supply chain services with quick‑turnaround production. An online tool, BOXCAD, allows customers to customize enclosure dimensions, colors, and cut‑outs. The facility is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

The distributor serves customers across industries that require electronic components, such as automation, industrial controls, and electronics manufacturing. Its line card includes products from franchised manufacturers across categories like semiconductors, circuit protection, and transformers.

Waterbury Electronic Supply emphasizes a “Distribution With a Personal Touch” approach, guided by principles of fair pricing, responsive service, and helping customers reduce costs. The company states it will direct customers to alternative providers when it cannot meet a need.
